text_block_list.text:
One day, when I headed to the library
in search of reference books――

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: Are you having some kind of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Actually, I was looking for a few reference books in preparation for the upcoming race, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was only able to find a single copy.
I was just pondering what to do about it.
choice_data_list: What kind of book are you looking for?
What kind of book are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's see... 'Secrets of Running', 'The Essence of Speed', 'Running Styles by Famous Umamusume', and then...

Grass Wonder continues listing off more book titles, one after another...
Tracking down all of them is going to be quite a chore.
choice_data_list: Let's take our time reading the book we found first.
Shall we look for it together?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 'Too much brooding dulls the wit,' as they say.
Time is finite, so I shall do just that~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, hmm.
I see, that's very informative~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure?
In that case, I would gladly take you up on it.

...It took quite a while,
but I managed to track down
every single book Grass Wonder was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You've been a great help, thank you so much. Thanks to you, my studying is going to make great progress~♪

Struggling alongside Grass Wonder to search for books
helped me become much more familiar with the library's collection.
